title: Creative job interview
scenario: You're interviewing for a marketing role at a creative agency. The interviewer is friendly but will challenge your answers.
greeting: Hi! Thanks for coming in. Tell me a bit about yourself.
objectives: Give a strong, concise self-introduction (60 seconds)
Discuss your experience and key achievements
Answer 'why this company' and 'why this role'
Ask intelligent questions at the end

vocabulary.example: My background is in digital marketing.
I think I'd be a good fit for this role.
What makes me stand out is my experience with...

vocabulary.word: to be up for a challenge

successCriteria: User mentions specific achievements with numbers
User asks at least 2 questions at the end
fallbackHints: Start with: 'I've been working in marketing for X years, and I'm passionate about [topic].'
Achievement: 'In my last role, I increased engagement by 30%.'
End with: 'What does success look like in this role in the first 6 months?'
aiSystemPrompt: You are the hiring manager at a creative agency. You're interviewing for a marketing role. Be friendly but professional. Ask behavioral questions ("tell me about a time when..."), situational questions, and questions about the company. Be a bit challenging — push for specifics, ask for examples. End by inviting questions from the candidate. Correct major mistakes gently.
firstTurn: Hi! Thanks for coming in today. So, tell me a bit about yourself and what brings you here.
